description: Ripple glass with wavelength-correct Cauchy dispersion: n(lambda) = A + B/lambda^2 sets each channel's sample offset, so blue bends hardest as real glass does. Fixes the dead-audio bug where u.config.y (the ripple count) was read as an audio level. Clicks emit bounded caustic wavefronts.
name: Liquid Prism

updatedParams.name: Prism Strength
updatedParams.description: Displacement amplitude of the refraction ripple.

updatedParams.name: Wave Frequency
updatedParams.description: Ripple wavenumber; mids and the local FFT band modulate it.

updatedParams.name: Flow Speed
updatedParams.description: Phase speed of the pointer ripple.

updatedParams.name: Aberration / Transparency
updatedParams.description: Dual-purpose: scales the Cauchy index spread AND sets base glass transparency.
